serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Good evening Mr. Landlord, what brings you here?
Landlord: What brings me here?! The whole building’s electricity got fucked for a moment and I have a sneaking suspicion that this is your doing!
You: W-why me? Geez. There are many other residents here.
Landlord: Well yes, but they all are asleep at this hour, unlike you, neet.
That’s some harsh words… sadly he’s not wrong.
You: W-well, maybe it was just regular maintenance? How could I even cause something like it, I didn’t mess with the power grid!
Landlord: Maybe you are right, but you are still pissing me off. By the way, I just bought platinum membership of the Private Police Force hehe.
You: And you are telling me this because? 
Landlord: Because now if anyone doesn’t pay me his rent on time I can force him out, legally. God bless America!
Is he for real?
You: Are you sure it’s legal? Isn’t it like, breaking human rights or something?
Landlord: Listen retard, are you literate?
You: What?
Landlord: I asked you if you can read goddammit! Just look up your lease agreement, section 4 if I’m correct. If you do not pay up your weekly rent, you are out! Until now I didn’t have the means to kick out problematic tenants, but I have now, thanks to PPF!
You: If I don’t pay, you are going to just kick me out?! It’s freezing cold outside!
Landlord: Not my problem kid. Remember, 800$ next week. Good luck and good night!
